  NOTES:
  - Lift the ternary Golay code of length 12 to Z_9, adjoin vector
  - (111111111111) & apply Construction A.
  - In "The Ternary Golay Code, the Integers Mod 9 and
  - the Coxeter-Todd Lattice" by A. R. Calderbank and N. J. A. Sloane
  - (IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, 42 (1996), 636-637)
  - we incorrectly claimed that this is
  - isomorphic to the Coxeter-Todd lattice K12.
  - However, the center density is only 1/3^6 not 1/3^3.
